name: Winny Immigration & Education Services Ltd.
summary: Winny Immigration & Education Services Ltd. engages in the provision of visa consultancy services to individuals for study, travel, work, business, and migration purposes. It offers training for language proficiency examinations; and consulting and processing a range of temporary and permanent residency visas. The company was founded on June 9, 2008 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
